title: The internet is thirsty

scenes.say: Every data centre runs thousands of servers, day and night. And almost all that power turns into heat.
scenes.caption: Every data centre runs thousands of servers, day and night. Almost all that power turns into heat.

scenes.say: To keep them from overheating, many data centres cool down with water.
scenes.caption: To keep them from overheating, many data centres cool down with water.

scenes.say: In India, a 2025 study found up to fifty data centres in regions facing extremely high water stress.
scenes.caption: A 2025 study found up to 50 Indian data centres in regions of extremely high water stress.

scenes.say: Chennai. Mumbai. Bengaluru. Cities where every drop already counts.
scenes.caption: Chennai. Mumbai. Bengaluru. Cities where every drop already counts.

scenes.say: Here's the good news. Smarter cooling is already here.
scenes.caption: Here's the good news: smarter cooling is already here.

scenes.say: Treated wastewater, instead of fresh drinking water.
scenes.caption: Treated wastewater, instead of fresh drinking water.

scenes.say: Air-cooled and closed-loop systems that need far less water.
scenes.caption: Air-cooled and closed-loop systems that need far less water.

scenes.say: And India's energy efficiency guidelines already recommend treated water for cooling.
scenes.caption: India's energy efficiency guidelines already recommend treated water for cooling.

scenes.say: Cool smarter, and India's digital growth doesn't have to cost its water.
scenes.caption: Cool smarter, and India's digital growth doesn't have to cost its water.
